policy.singleSource: GitHub product catalog + editorial image registry + this TikTok-publication registry + per-episode production ledger
policy.preflight: Before proposing any video, re-fetch the current site product list, image registry, and production-status. Block a product if listed here as previously created, possibly in earlier production, or already published. Also block reuse of the SAME original female styling image or asset ID across other products when any record is published, created or reserved. Do not auto-clear unknown states.
policy.sensitivity: Conservatively block ambiguous older material to avoid duplicate proposals; user can explicitly authorize a remake.
policy.recording: Only set publication='verified_published' with a directly inspected TikTok post URL, screenshot showing post and identity, or an explicit user-provided matching post link where the content is reviewed. Preserve productId, imageAssetId, episodeId, post URL, observed date and confidence.
policy.nextStep: Obtain a profile export, a list of published TikTok post URLs, or access through a connected service that can list TikTok posts. Match each video to product and site woman by video frames or thumbnails.
